blocks.orig: Deep in the suburbs of Arusha, nestled in a coffee estate bordering the Maasai country, lies a beautiful private refuge called Meru House Lekisilai. Half of its name derives from the majestic Mount Meru, from which there is an unrivalled view from the hotel. The second half, Lekisilai, honours the name of another nearby mountain, held sacred by the Maasai. The lodge was once built as a family home, designed by the architect owner, and boasts six tastefully decorated ensuite rooms named after birds you can see and hear around the lodge. Take the time to relax by the swimming pool, take part in guided walks, go on mountain bike tours or join a basketball game – there is no need to get bored here!
blocks.html: In the suburbs of Arusha, tucked into a coffee estate on the edge of Maasai country, you find a lovely private retreat called Meru House Lekisilai. The first part of its name comes from the impressive Mount Meru, which you can see from the hotel with an unbeatable view. The second part, Lekisilai, refers to another mountain nearby that the Maasai regard as sacred. Originally built as a family home and designed by its architect owner, the lodge has six tastefully furnished ensuite rooms, each named after a bird you can spot or hear around the lodge. Unwind by the swimming pool, join guided walks, go on mountain bike tours or play a game of basketball – boredom is not an option here!
